text:
elaine: Quick thread: finalizing docs PR to replace legacy audit-log examples. Need a one-line JSONL sample (tenant-scoped), a CLI export example, and SOC2-friendly retention bullets before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/521

samir: paste JSONL sample and i'll add it to docs/snippets/audit/sample-event.jsonl

elaine: sample: ```json
{"ts":"2026-03-18T15:10:22Z","event_type":"model.invoke","tenant_id":"org-zen","actor":"user:lee","resource":"model/fast-serve","meta":{"tokens_in":24}}
```

ben: add short note: "filter by tenant_id and event_type to scope exports."

maria: legal: avoid absolute deletion promises. prefer 'default retention' language, call out legal holds, and confirm exported snapshots are customer-managed.

lex-legal: suggested copy: "Default audit logs are retained for 90 days. Privileged events (access or permission changes) are retained for 180 days. Customers may request extended retention via contract. Legal holds or regulatory obligations may supersede deletion schedules. We do not alter customer exports; retention of exported snapshots is managed by the customer."

elaine: will add bullets under Compliance > Audit logs and an FAQ Q: "Can I extend retention?" -> "Yes, contact your account manager."

samir: CLI example for docs: ```bash
ri audit export --tenant org-zen --from 2026-02-16 --to 2026-03-18 --format jsonl --out ./org-zen-audit-30d.jsonl
```

samir: SDK helper snippets uploaded to docs/snippets/ruby/audit_count.rb and docs/snippets/go/audit_count.go; will link instead of inlining.

ben: small styling: label bullets 'Default retention' and 'Privileged retention' so readers scan quickly.

deploy-bot: PR 521 bumped to staging at 3179990052 by @elaine :white_check_mark:

elaine: holding prod merge until lex-legal and maria confirm final wording. will run docs test that parses the sample. ping me for anything else. :thumbsup:
